title: Who records the stand-up decisions: conductor@web-summit.dinis or team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo
detail: WS-107 names conductor@web-summit.dinis as the recorder; the open 2 November 18:00 item recommends team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo drafting from the chair's words, with the chair confirming. Capture options for the notes are in WS-96.
recommend: team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo drafts, the chair confirms in one line
